europe_now.summary: Polish police and security services have issued warnings regarding an alleged assassination plot targeting Prime Minister Donald Tusk. The authorities are actively investigating the security breach.

europe_now.summary: Pope Leo announced that he will undergo a medical procedure to treat an early-stage lung nodule. The Vatican disclosed the upcoming surgery details following the announcement.

top_stories.title: Energy Infrastructure Stances in Ukraine Conflict
top_stories.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Ukraine is prepared to halt strikes on oil refineries if Moscow ceases attacks on energy infrastructure. Meanwhile, international discussions continue regarding the broader conflict and diplomatic positions.

top_stories.title: Spanish Election Campaigns and Housing Demonstrations
top_stories.summary: Political leaders in Spain have officially kicked off their electoral campaigns for the upcoming vote. These campaign launches coincide with widespread public demonstrations and protests addressing the ongoing housing crisis.
